status_note: Internal research ledger. Exact finite calculations and derivations are not empirical validation, independent proof review, or novelty/priority evidence. The two-feed CRN is an abstract open reaction/reporting interface pending chemical realization.

claims.exact_statement: For the stated two-stage open mass-action CRN, the two candidate rate tables have identical pointwise full-state CLE drift and covariance at every source and every deterministic nonnegative feed waveform. The exact tables also have equal M0, M1, M2 per feed action, while M3 differs by -6 under F0 and -12 under F1. This follows because the rate difference is 2 epsilon_a alpha_k, with alpha=(1,-3,3,-1), whose k^0,k^1,k^2 moments vanish and k^3 moment is -6, and each jump vector is affine in k.
assumptions: Finite species state vector includes catalyst, clamped feed, and all reporter/product coordinates
Reaction jumps have the stated affine form b_{i,a}+k u_i
Feed setting multiplies the source propensity by C_i F_a
Candidate action-specific rates are known and positive
claims.status: Exact algebraic construction and internally checked with Fraction arithmetic. The nullspace/signature mechanism is prior art; no novelty is claimed for sourcewise CLE aliasing.
claims.proof_path: CYCLE3_REPORT.md, 'Two-stage CRN and exact CLE identity'; adaptive_cle_pair.py
claims.novelty_boundary: Faul-Hoessly-Xia provide the sourcewise lifted CLE signature interface; this file provides a concrete two-stage action-indexed instantiation and feedback test. The single-event regime is a jump-process assay, not an asserted accurate CLE approximation.
claims.costs: No energetic or physical actuator model is established. Displayed constants use normalized feed and catalyst conventions; actual molecular units require volume and concentration calibration.
claims.falsifier: A nonzero calibrated difference in any of M0, M1, M2 for any source/action, or a measured non-affine mark-to-jump map, falsifies this parameterized CLE identity.
claims.next_gate: Map the abstract reporter/feed reactions to an atom-balanced, experimentally measurable catalytic system and independently audit the source signatures.

claims.exact_statement: With equal prior, two event-resolved marks, first feed F1, and a second feed selected as F1 after k0 in {1,3} and F0 after k0 in {2,4}, the exact CTMC likelihood-ratio classifier has Bayes error 1309/32400. The best of all four fixed two-pulse schedules has error 193/4050 at F1,F1. The adaptive reduction is 47/6480 (235/1544, about 15.22% relative), with no likelihood ties. The policy is Bayes-optimal among the two-step causal policies in this two-action menu.
assumptions: Known candidate models and action-conditioned mark probabilities
Initial C0=1 and deterministic progression C0->C1->C2
No competing/reverse reactions, hidden conformations, or product feedback over the two events
Each stage product category is read before the next pulse
Equal prior and terminal 0-1 Bayes loss
The second-stage waiting time carries no information because total hazard is 9 for both hypotheses/actions
claims.status: Exact rational dynamic-programming calculation, internally checked by executable script. Not an empirical catalytic result.
claims.proof_path: CYCLE3_REPORT.md, 'Measurable two-pulse schedule and matched static test'; adaptive_cle_pair.py
claims.novelty_boundary: Adaptive controlled sensing and finite-horizon Bayes DP are established. No general adaptive-control theorem or priority claim is made; the candidate result is this explicit numerical application.
claims.costs: Both policies consume two feed molecules and make two output observations under equal per-pulse pricing. Adaptive control adds online readout/update and expected switching cost; compare scalarized objective only using measured costs.
claims.falsifier: Replace the candidate probabilities by calibrated action-conditioned mark data and recompute the exact DP; the claimed gain fails if it is not below the best fixed schedule, especially after measured control costs.
claims.next_gate: Run a blinded assay/simulation with the same event count, likelihood access, readout channel, and measured cost accounting for adaptive and four fixed schedules.

claims.exact_statement: Under a known symmetric label channel that replaces each true mark with a uniform random category with probability rho, the exact DP gives best-fixed/adaptive errors 0.0706469/0.0654204 at rho=0.05, 0.0909800/0.0889150 at rho=0.10, and equal error 0.1274410 at rho=0.20 for this model/menu.
assumptions: The same independent known confusion channel applies at each stage and under both actions/hypotheses
Replacement can return the original category
Rates and channel parameters are exactly known
claims.status: Finite exact-rational channel calculation; not a measured sensor result.
claims.proof_path: CYCLE3_REPORT.md, 'Noise, hidden states, and falsification'; adaptive_cle_pair.py

claims.exact_statement: Under common base feed/observation/command/time costs and feed action costs c0,c1, switch cost csw, online readout cost conline, and update cost cupdate, the adaptive policy's expected excess cost over fixed F1,F1 is (4429/9000)(c0-c1+csw)+conline+cupdate. It improves Bayes-risk-plus-lambda-cost only if lambda times this excess is below 47/6480.
assumptions: Equal prior
Common two readout and two base pulse costs cancel
Second pulse chooses F0 with probability 4429/9000
Switch cost is incurred only when changing from first F1 to second F0
Scalarized risk-plus-cost objective is selected
claims.status: Conditional cost identity under the declared symbolic accounting; no net energy or efficiency claim.
claims.proof_path: CYCLE3_REPORT.md, cost paragraph and exact feed-action frequency in adaptive_cle_pair.py
claims.novelty_boundary: Accounting application, not a thermodynamic theorem. Isotope/feed replacement itself is not assumed to induce the rate profiles.
claims.costs: Actual chemical potentials, feed purchase, switching energy, sensing, computation, calibration, and clock/latency must be measured. Barrier/actuator analogies are outside this model.
claims.falsifier: Measured costs yielding nonpositive net scalarized gain falsify any claim of operational advantage, though not the bare Bayes-risk arithmetic.
claims.next_gate: Predefine the objective and measure all cost terms before evaluating deployment value.
